question: What percentage of tests will be positive for influenza in the United States for the week ending October 10, 2026, in CDC data?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the percent of tests positive for influenza in the United States for the week ending 2026-10-10 in CDC's Percent of Tests Positive for Viral Respiratory Pathogens (data.cdc.gov dataset seuz-s2cv), as posted on 2026-10-30.
research:
Quick update: I've finished searching and am writing up the findings. Everything below is limited to information available by 2026-08-31.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the CDC dataset "Percent of Tests Positive for Viral Respiratory Pathogens" ([data.cdc.gov seuz-s2cv](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/seuz-s2cv.json?pathogen=Influenza&$order=week_end%20ASC&$limit=200)). Its fields are week_end, pathogen ("Influenza") and percent_test_positivity. It is weekly, with weeks ending on Saturday. The value that counts is the week ending 2026-10-10, as posted on 2026-10-30.
- The latest weeks that would have been published by 2026-08-31 are below. I read them from a later download, so they may differ slightly from what was posted at the time. [source](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/seuz-s2cv.json?pathogen=Influenza&$order=week_end%20DESC&$limit=20)
  - 2026-07-18: 0.5%
  - 2026-07-25: 0.5%
  - 2026-08-01: 0.4%
  - 2026-08-08: 0.5%
  - 2026-08-15: 0.7%
  - 2026-08-22: 0.8% (most likely the latest published value as of Aug 31)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The target week is about 6 weeks after the latest data point.
- Positivity has doubled since early August, from 0.4% to 0.8% over 3 weeks. That is unusual for August. In 2024 and 2025 it stayed flat or fell over the same weeks (see section 4).

## 3. Recent news
- I could not find any US news or FluView commentary published on or before 2026-08-31 about flu rising in late summer.
- Early-to-mid 2026: Australia's 2026 season was running at about half of 2025's record. By mid-May it had about 31,874 cases, mostly H3N2, including subclade K. [SBS](https://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/australia-flu-cases-down-2026-experts-warn-risk-remains/w11fju6ws), [SMC](https://smc.org.au/our-latest/news/what-to-expect-from-australias-2026-flu-season)
- January 2026: H3N2 subclade K ("Super-K") drove the 2025-26 Northern Hemisphere season. [The New Daily](https://www.thenewdaily.com.au/life/health/2026/01/13/new-flu-strain-super-k)

## 4. Base rates
All values are from the same dataset, comparing the late-August reading with the early-to-mid October reading in each year:

| Year | Late Aug | Early-mid Oct | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2022 | n/a (series starts 10-01: 2.0) | 10-08: 2.7 | Early H3N2 season, already above 1.5% in October |
| 2023 | 08-19: 0.9 | 10-07: 1.1, 10-14: 1.3 | +0.2 to +0.4 |
| 2024 | 08-24: 0.4 | 10-05: 0.7, 10-12: 0.7 | +0.3 |
| 2025 | 08-23: 0.4 | 10-04: 0.5, 10-11: 0.5 | +0.1 |

- In normal years, positivity moves about +0.1 to +0.4 points over these 7 weeks, roughly 1.2 to 1.75 times the late-August level. Applied to 0.8%, that gives about 0.9 to 1.4%.
- 2026 is already rising fast. If the August trend continues (+0.1 to +0.2 per week), the value would go past the question's 1.5% upper bound. 2022, an early H3N2 season, shows October positivity well above 1.5% is possible.
- From the low point, 2023 to 2025 needed about 10 to 13 weeks to go from roughly 0.5% to 1.5%. In 2024 and 2025 the rise started in late September or October, not August.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold markets on this metric.
- I found no expert forecast for October 2026 US flu positivity. The CDC FluSight forecasts target hospitalizations and normally start in the fall.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- New data each Friday: about 6 more weekly points before the target week, starting with the weeks ending Aug 29 and Sep 5.
- Late August and September: schools reopen, which usually speeds up respiratory virus spread.
- 2026-10-04: the 2026-27 flu season officially starts (MMWR week 40). The target week, ending Oct 10, is the first week of the season.
- The CDC fall vaccination campaign runs September to October.
- Reported values can be revised before the 2026-10-30 posting that decides the question.
- Watch whether the West Coast or Southern regions lead the rise, and the late-winter trend in Southern Hemisphere H3N2.

Sources: [CDC data.cdc.gov seuz-s2cv](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/seuz-s2cv.json?pathogen=Influenza&$order=week_end%20ASC&$limit=200), [SBS](https://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/australia-flu-cases-down-2026-experts-warn-risk-remains/w11fju6ws), [SMC](https://smc.org.au/our-latest/news/what-to-expect-from-australias-2026-flu-season), [The New Daily](https://www.thenewdaily.com.au/life/health/2026/01/13/new-flu-strain-super-k)
